validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid e-mail address, like name@company.com.
validation.termsRequired: Accept the terms to create your account.

rules.common: Not a common or easy-to-guess password

errors.too_common: This password is too common. Choose a less predictable one — a short phrase works well.
errors.contains_email: Don't reuse your e-mail address in your password.
errors.blank: The password can't be only spaces.
errors.invalid: This password doesn't meet the requirements.

oauth.errorTitle: We couldn't sign you in with that account

errors.state: The sign-in attempt expired or was started in another browser. Start again from this page.
errors.denied: Access was cancelled at the provider. Nothing was shared with Gouvra.
errors.exchange: The provider didn't confirm your identity. Try again in a moment.
errors.email_unverified: Your e-mail address isn't verified with that provider. Verify it there, or sign in with your e-mail and password.
errors.unreachable: We couldn't reach the provider. Check your connection and try again.
errors.disabled: This sign-in method is turned off on this instance.
errors.unknown: Something interrupted the sign-in. Try again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.csrf: This page is out of date. Reload it, then try again.
errors.network: We can't reach Gouvra right now. Check your connection — what you typed is kept.
errors.server: Gouvra hit an unexpected error. Try again; if it persists, share the diagnostic ID.
errors.signupDisabled: Sign-up is turned off on this instance. Ask an administrator for an invitation.

login.title: Sign in to Gouvra
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Your agents are where you left them.
login.inviteHint: Sign in with the invited address to accept your invitation.
login.invalid: Incorrect e-mail or password. Check both and try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: You'll confirm your e-mail, then set up your first workspace.
register.inviteHint: Use the address your invitation was sent to — you'll join the workspace right after confirming it.
register.terms: I accept the terms of use of this Gouvra instance.
register.sentBody: If {{email}} can be used for a new account, a confirmation link is on its way. It expires in 24 hours.
register.sentHelp: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, then send the link again.

resend.done: If the address can receive it, a new link is on its way.

verify.successNext: You're signed in. Next, set up your first workspace.
verify.successReady: You're signed in and ready to go.
verify.successInvite: You're signed in. Your invitation is waiting.
verify.invalidBody: Confirmation links work once and expire after 24 hours. Get a new one below.
verify.requestSubtitle: Enter the address you signed up with. If its account is waiting for confirmation, we'll send a new link.
verify.requestSent: If {{email}} has an account waiting for confirmation, a new link is on its way.
verify.pendingBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account — it expires in 24 hours.
verify.pendingStill: Your address isn't confirmed yet. Open the link from the e-mail, then try again.
verify.wrongAddress: Wrong address? Sign out and create your account again with the right one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's e-mail address. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent it a link to reset the password. The link expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll be signed in right after. Your other devices will be signed out.
reset.successBody: You're signed in. Every other session was signed out, for safety.
reset.missingTitle: Open the link from your e-mail
reset.missingBody: This page needs the reset link we sent you. Request a new one if you can't find it.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once and expire after 1 hour. Request a new one to continue.

confirmEmail.successBody: You now sign in with {{email}}. Your other sessions were signed out.
confirmEmail.invalidBody: Address-change links work once and expire after 24 hours. Start the change again from your account.
confirmEmail.takenTitle: This address is already in use
confirmEmail.takenBody: Another account now uses this address. Your sign-in address hasn't changed.
confirmEmail.missingTitle: Open the link from your e-mail
confirmEmail.missingBody: This page needs the confirmation link we sent to your new address.

invite.title: Join {{workspace}}
invite.invitedBy: {{inviter}} invited you to join this workspace as {{role}}.
invite.invitedAnonymous: You're invited to join this workspace as {{role}}.
invite.signedOutHint: Sign in or sign up with the address the invitation was sent to.
invite.mismatchTitle: This invitation is for another address
invite.mismatchBody: It was sent to {{hint}}, but you're signed in as {{email}}. Sign out, then sign in or create an account with the invited address.
invite.expiredBody: Invitations are valid for 7 days. Ask {{inviter}} to send you a new one.
invite.expiredBodyAnonymous: Invitations are valid for 7 days. Ask a workspace admin to send you a new one.
invite.revokedBody: A workspace admin cancelled it. Ask them for a new invitation if you still need access.
invite.acceptedBody: If it was you, the workspace is already in your list.
invite.invalidBody: Make sure you opened the full link from the e-mail. If it still fails, ask for a new invitation.
invite.missingTitle: Open the link from your invitation e-mail
invite.missingBody: This page needs the invitation link you received by e-mail.
